Step 1 said nothing was left over, but the partner's remark in the final review does leave two things open. SMS batching was kept out of plan 15 on purpose, and the batch size of 50 is a watch item. Both have closure conditions, so both belong in the backlog. That makes the "nothing deferred" status header wrong, so I'd correct it first.

I would not put those two items in the closure note of the ticked entry as drafted. Ticked items are never revisited, so open work recorded there would be lost. The tick stays a plain pointer instead.

**1. Correct the status header in the plan (not yet retired):**

**Status: COMPLETE (2026-10-30)** — executed via subagent-driven-development; deferred items in specs/deferred_items.md
</edit>

This replaces the existing line `**Status: COMPLETE (2026-10-30)** — executed via subagent-driven-development; nothing deferred`.

**2. Tick the earlier entry (ticking pass):**

      run takes about 40 minutes for 9,000 loans. See

      → done in plan 15
</edit>

This replaces the first entry under `## 11-overdue-notices — 2026-10-02`, with no closure note. The fines and holiday entries stay untouched.

**3. Append this plan's section, newest last, at the end of the file:**

<edit path="specs/deferred_items.md">

## 15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30
- [ ] SMS reminders still make one gateway call per message; plan 15 batched
      e-mail only and kept SMS out of scope (partner: SMS batching is the
      next thing wanted). See specs/plans/completed/15-reminder-batching.md.
      Size: plan. Done when: SMS reminders are sent in batches, as e-mail
      reminders are, and the change is covered by tests.
- [ ] E-mail batch size is fixed at 50; leave it until the mail host rejects
      a batch (final review, owner ruled defer). See
      specs/plans/completed/15-reminder-batching.md. Size: quick-fix.
      Revisit if: the mail host rejects a batch with `421 Too many messages`.
</edit>

No commands in this step. The edits land with the protocol's other commits. Step 4 (running `deferred_stats.py`) and step 5 (retiring the plan) come next.

**Message to partner:**

Step 3 of the completion protocol is written. Three changes need your eye:

- **Ticked:** the per-message SMTP connection entry from `11-overdue-notices` is marked `→ done in plan 15`. I left the SMS and batch-size notes out of it, because a ticked item is never looked at again.
- **Two new items** under `## 15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30`:
  - SMS batching, sized `plan`, which you named as the next thing you want. It is done when SMS reminders go out in batches like e-mail.
  - The batch size of 50, sized `quick-fix`. Revisit it if the mail host rejects a batch with `421 Too many messages`.
- **Header corrected:** I had stamped plan 15 "nothing deferred". Since these two items are now recorded, it reads "deferred items in specs/deferred_items.md".

I didn't know the SMS code paths, so that item cites only the plan, not specific files. Tell me if you'd like them added, or if you'd rather the size or closure wording differ. Otherwise I'll go on to the backlog stats and the retire commit.
